methodology: Covers named text, reasoning and coding releases, publicly announced external previews, and explicitly dated model updates. Standalone media, embedding and moderation models are excluded.
Announcement and availability are distinct events. Additional API access milestones are included when later than initial product access.
Precise announcement times identify a verified official post, not necessarily the earliest livestream mention. Availability times are unknown unless separately evidenced.
A date-only source is not converted to UTC+8. Its weekday_utc8 and datetime_utc8 remain null. Plot positions use the source calendar date and are explicitly marked approximate.
Snapshot suffixes are identifiers, not release dates. Rolling aliases and product-only updates are labelled; aliases are not counted as additional foundational models.
Raw RSS publication values are retained where found but not promoted to verified timestamps. Some values disagree with contemporaneous official posts.
Retirements, rollbacks, pricing changes, prompt-only changes and reasoning-budget adjustments are not new model releases. Relevant rollback notes are retained.
A release entry may represent a distinct model, a named variant, a rolling alias launch, or a documented update. Entry count is not a count of unique trained models.
